A '''planet''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], near the border of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] territory. The world was conquered by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces under control of [[Rohlan Dyre]], a [[Mandalorian Crusaders|Mandalorian Crusader]] who was trying to escape the army so he could discover the true motivations behind Mandalorian expansion into Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]].
